steps.title: Create a Pipedrive account
steps.detail: Sign up at pipedrive.com if you don't already have one. You need a user account to access the developer portal.

steps.title: Register as a developer
steps.detail: Go to https://developers.pipedrive.com/ and sign in with your Pipedrive account. Accept the developer terms to access the Marketplace developer console.

steps.title: Create a new app in the developer console
steps.detail: In the Marketplace developer console, click 'Create app'. Fill in app name, description, logo, and company details. On the 'OAuth & access scopes' tab, add your redirect URI(s) — must be HTTPS and exact match. Select required scopes (base, webhooks:read, webhooks:full, etc.). Save to get your client_id and client_secret.

steps.title: Implement the authorization code flow
steps.detail: Redirect users to https://oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/authorize?client_id={client_id}&redirect_uri={redirect_uri}&state={random_state}. After user clicks 'Allow and install', Pipedrive redirects back with ?code={auth_code}&state={state}. Exchange the code for tokens via POST to https://oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/token with Basic auth (base64(client_id:client_secret)) and form body: grant_type=authorization_code&code={auth_code}&redirect_uri={redirect_uri}.

steps.title: Implement token refresh
steps.detail: Access tokens expire in ~1 hour (expires_in=3599). To refresh, POST to https://oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/token with Basic auth and form body: grant_type=refresh_token&refresh_token={refresh_token}. Store the new access_token and refresh_token (rotate).

steps.title: Test with your own Pipedrive account (private app)
steps.detail: Install the app on your own company account via the OAuth flow. Verify API calls work using the returned api_domain (e.g., https://your-company.pipedrive.com). Private apps support up to 3 users without Marketplace review.

steps.title: Prepare for public Marketplace submission
steps.detail: Add privacy policy URL, terms of service, support email, and detailed app description in the developer console. Ensure all redirect URIs are production HTTPS endpoints. Test uninstall/reinstall flow.

steps.title: Submit for Marketplace review
steps.detail: Click 'Submit for review' in the developer console. Pipedrive reviews functionality, security, and compliance. Community reports indicate reviews can take 2+ months. You'll receive feedback or approval via email.

steps.title: Publish to Marketplace
steps.detail: Once approved, toggle the app to 'Public' in the console. It will appear in the Pipedrive Marketplace for any user to install.

verdict.label: Easy
verdict.s2Limit: Private apps work for up to 3 users; public apps need Marketplace approval.
verdict.oneLiner: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow only; public Marketplace apps require review (often 2+ months). No client-credentials or PKCE.

blockers.fix: Copy the redirect URI exactly from the 'OAuth & access scopes' tab. Use HTTPS. Ensure no extra query parameters. Test with a known-good value first.
blockers.cause: The redirect_uri in the authorize request or token request does not exactly match the URI registered in the developer console (including trailing slash, scheme, port).
blockers.symptom: redirect_uri_mismatch error on authorization or token exchange

blockers.fix: Exchange code immediately after redirect. On refresh failure, restart the full OAuth flow.
blockers.cause: Authorization code expired (codes valid ~5 minutes), already used, or refresh token revoked/revoked due to scope change.
blockers.symptom: invalid_grant error when exchanging code or refreshing token

blockers.fix: Use a long-lived refresh token from a user-authorized session, or use a personal API token (not OAuth) for server-to-server scripts.
blockers.cause: Pipedrive does not support OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow (confirmed by Pipedrive staff in community). Only authorization code flow is available.
blockers.symptom: Need machine-to-machine access without user interaction

blockers.fix: Ensure submission is complete (privacy policy, test account, demo video). Follow up via devcommunity.pipedrive.com. No reapply_penalty — you can update the same submission.
blockers.cause: Marketplace review queue backlog; no published SLA.
blockers.symptom: Public app stuck in review for months
